lyrics:
[Intro: finger snaps, lazy guitar lick, low hum]

[Verse 1: talk-sung male voice, half a grin]
Met her at a red light in nineteen ninety-eight
Hair out the window, Oklahoma plate
Been riding shotgun in that laugh ever since
Thirty years of mornings and I ain't bored yet

[Chorus: sung, smooth harmonies, slow groove]
She's got laugh lines and county lines
And I know every one by heart
That crease right there's the year the twins were born
That one's from dancing in the dark
I take it slow, I know the way
I could travel it with my eyes closed, blind
Laugh lines and county lines

[Verse 2: talk-sung, snaps and bass]
Them magazine girls ain't been anywhere yet
No map on their faces, no stories, no debt
Mine's got a road for every joke I ever told
And one or two for the ones that got old

[Chorus: sung, smooth harmonies, slow groove]
She's got laugh lines and county lines
And I know every one by heart
That crease right there's the year the twins were born
That one's from dancing in the dark
I take it slow, I know the way
I could travel it with my eyes closed, blind
Laugh lines and county lines

[Bridge: snaps only, spoken low]
She says, "Quit staring." I say, "I'm reading."
She says, "What's it say?"
I say, "Keep going. Speed limit: easy."

[Final Chorus: full groove, harmonies stacked]
She's got laugh lines and county lines
And I know every one by heart
That crease right there's the year the twins were born
That one's from dancing in the dark
I take it slow, I know the way
